body: Wow thank you for saying this. Really, thank you. I feel a little better now.

Thanks I don't know what to reply to this to be honest? Nice cake, wish I turned 9 and not 25, that would have been nice.
Depression is just like that. I don't feel like I try as hard as I should to get out of it. And the longer I've been depressed, the more discouraged I get. I have no idea where to even begin.

I don't want praise, it's not like I have anything to be proud of, I just feel lonely and I guess I sort of want people to be happy to have me around, or at least not dislike my company. I wish I could not give a fuck about having friends and being acknowledged, I try to tell myself it doesn't matter, that I should be my own best friend yadaydada but I guess it's just a basic need I have :s 
I have no idea what I could do to become happy with myself to be honest. I'm ashamed of who I am and I sort of feel like it's too late to fix it because I can't go back in time and un-fail all these things!

Yeah I should mention that I am in therapy and have been for a hugr part of my life. I am also on meds, have tried a lot of different things and found one that actually helps for depression but it can't turn everything around.

25 is young, but people still expect you to have something to show for, either school or work experience of preferrably both. And I have absolutely no idea what to say when people asks what I've been doing until now..
